nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: Influenza B is in the ‘High’ category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category. The other respiratory viruses we monitor (RSV, Influenza A, HMPV, & EV-D68) are in the ‘Low’ category nationwide & not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/zwKuTiF7HO

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/ovrByjXb5o

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.1 variant in light green (77.9%) and KP.3 in light blue (10.2%) make up approximately 88% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/Km6HOCGnI5

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. Flu B is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. 34% and 52% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/9aNng7ySE4

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 26 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 7 in the South, & 6 in the Northeast. As of 4/30/25, 17 states have reported infected cattle herds. Most recent wastewater detections have been in CA, MN, and NJ. https://t.co/VlexBWvEEV

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 36% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/Eu8k2FUmFa

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally, and is near onset. 48% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV. https://t.co/YZ9xA5Q9zR

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/u9evcVYuyJ
